title: to 5: Performance and Testing of Teleprotection Equipment of Power Systems, Part 1: Narrow Band Command Systems
clause_1_scope: 1.1 This standard ( Part 1/Sec 1 ) covers general aspects of narrow-band single-signal and multisignal equipment for teleprotection. It also applies to voice frequency equipment which is used in connection with various telecommunication systems, such as power line carrier ( PLC ), radio link, rented circuits, leased or owned cables. Narrow band systems include audio frequency systems operating within a 4 kHz maximum band, and PLC channels within a maximum of 4 kHz bandwidth ( for one direction of transmission ).

The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
